key_terms.نَقْعًا: Clouds of dust raised by the hooves of horses

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'naq' refer to in Surah Al-Adiyat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the physical prowess of the warhorses as a metaphor for the swift execution of divine will, often linked to the concept of *furqan* (discernment) between truth and falsehood. The raising of dust (*naq'*) symbolizes the visible impact of their movement, serving as an oath to underscore the certainty of the Resurrection and the accountability of human deeds.
